regime_context: The detector shows a broad eligible rotation (13 of 16 themes) led by Big Banks, with Base Metals & Copper close behind and Gold Miners showing the strongest trend-health among non-crowded scorable themes. Momentum rank is an attention lens (rank-IC ~0), the rotation read is non-directional, and the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control; with a 24-call track record showing 0.5 directional accuracy, all leans are low conviction.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the leader and headline theme but is crowded and the rotation read is non-directional, so I would not initiate fresh risk. Momentum rank is not a return edge and crowding is only a size-down caution; this is an avoid call, not a fade or short.
evidence: rotation leader is Big Banks, rotation directional false, one_narrative false
theses.dissent: Banks may continue to grind higher if rate/carry and credit conditions stay supportive, and crowding can resolve through time rather than a drawdown.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO outperforms both XBM.TO and XGD.TO by more than 5 percentage points before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the strongest trend-quality eligible theme among scorable names: full breadth, non-crowded, and the only top-tier scorable theme with hurst_tag trend and a high durability_bar. This supports a conditional trend-following lean via the validated absolute-trend gate, not a return forecast.
evidence: gate_helps true and absolute_trend_gate is the validated risk-control leg
theses.dissent: Precious metals miners are sensitive to real yields and USD; a hawkish repricing or risk-on rotation could break the trend quickly despite the detector's current trend tag.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 20-day low before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the nearest non-crowded challenger with full breadth and solid durability. This is a conditional trend-following lean on an eligible, non-crowded commodity theme, cleaner than chasing the crowded Big Banks leader, not a rotation prediction.
evidence: rotation.challenger is Base Metals & Copper with margin 0.075
theses.dissent: Industrial metals depend heavily on global growth and China demand; a demand disappointment or USD bounce could reverse the trend despite favorable detector texture.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its own 20-day low before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
